items.fundingSource: California Department of Education, Strengthening Career and Technical Education for the 21st Century Act Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - Strengthening Career and Technical Education for the 21st Century Act - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Authorizes up to $790,043 for The Unity Council to provide child development services
enrichment.summary: The Board authorizes a subcontract of part of the district's 2023-24 child development funding to The Unity Council for child development services, up to $790,043 with no administrative fee. The term is July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024, and the Council must follow the terms of the state contract.

vendor.name: The Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc. (The Unity Council)

items.fundingSource: California Department of Education, CSPP Grant (#CSPP-3021)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - The Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc. dba The Unity Council - Early Childhood Education

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $500,000 federal grant for human trafficking prevention education through 2028
enrichment.summary: The district would accept a $500,000 grant from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services for human trafficking prevention education for staff, students and caregivers, and to help carry out the school safety protocol on human trafficking. The grant runs September 30, 2023 through September 29, 2028.

vendor.name: United States Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families

items.fundingSource: United States Department of Health and Human Services

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - United States Department of Health and Human Services - Human Trafficking Youth Prevention Education (HTYPE) Demonstration Program - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves the minutes of the Board's October 25, 2023 regular meeting
enrichment.summary: The Board is asked to approve the written minutes of its regular meeting held October 25, 2023, prepared by staff shortly after that meeting. No money is involved.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Regular Meeting – October 25, 2023

enrichment.headline: Approves 2023-24 Measure G1 grant proposals for named schools, as the oversight commission recommended
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution approving the 2023-2024 Measure G1 grant proposals for named schools, following the recommendation of the Measure G1 Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission. The text does not state dollar amounts or list the schools.

items.group: Measure G1 Commission – October 24, 2023 - Shivani Grover, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Measure G1 Funding Allocation - Measure G1 - Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission

enrichment.headline: Adds $21,414.80 to King Construction Inspection's contract for East Oakland Pride alarm work
enrichment.summary: King Construction Inspection will provide more state-required inspector of record services for the fire intrusion alarm replacement at East Oakland Pride Elementary School. The contract limit rises from $49,052.00 to $70,446.80 and the end date moves from June 30, 2023 to November 30, 2023, 153 more days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 2, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction– King Construction Inspection, Inc. – East Oakland Pride Elementary School Fire Intrusion Alarm Replacement Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $23,359.60 to King Construction Inspection's contract for MLK Elementary alarm work
schools: Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School
enrichment.summary: King Construction Inspection will keep providing inspector of record services for the fire intrusion alarm replacement at Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School. The contract limit rises from $47,748.00 to $71,107.60 and the end date is extended to November 30, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 2, Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction– King Construction Inspection, Inc. – Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School Fire Intrusion Alarm Replacement Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Approves $50,914 for Terraphase Engineering environmental review for Roosevelt Middle modernization
enrichment.summary: Terraphase Engineering will provide California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) consulting for the Roosevelt Middle School modernization project. The amount includes a $4,629 contingency for additional services, if needed. Work is scheduled to start November 9, 2023 and run until November 9, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Engineering Services Agreement – Terraphase Engineering, Inc. – Roosevelt Middle School- Modernization Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays EDesign-C $35,607 to study solar upgrades at Elmhurst United and Manzanita schools
enrichment.summary: EDesign-C, Inc., an Oakland company, will evaluate the electrical systems at Elmhurst United Middle School and Manzanita Community Elementary School and write a feasibility report on upgrading to solar equipment. The agreement is for $35,607.00, plus a $3,237.00 contingency for additional services if needed. Work is scheduled to run from November 9, 2023 to November 9, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Engineering Services - EDesign-C, Inc.- Elmhurst United Middle School and Manzanita Community Elementary School - Electrical Upgrade Design Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
